## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `af460eb4b6b7d1a28d4ef49edb1ca6a9188f00dc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json + .changeset/28476-skills-ui-view-filter-any-of-group.md, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (`VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS` :315-325, `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES` :375-400, `normalizeFilterOperator` :402-, `VIEW_FILTER_NESTED_GROUP_GUIDANCE` / `VIEW_FILTER_OR_SPELLING_GUIDANCE` / `VIEW_FILTER_GROUP_STRAY_RULE_KEY_GUIDANCE` :507-540, `ViewFilterRuleSchema` :1048-1092, `isViewFilterOrGroup` :1119-1122, `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` :1124-1226, `ViewFilterElementSchema` :1270-1300), packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts :190-203, packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts (guidance refusal), packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts :2838-2860 (`['or', ...]` logical node), packages/lint/src/filter-walk.ts :223 and :320-324, packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts :493, ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts :1389-1418, ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts :198-206 and :300-307, ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts :9-46, ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx :526-565, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridQuery.ts :39, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts :186-190 and :228, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterOrGroup.roundTrip-28370.test.tsx :116-156, content/docs/ui/views.mdx :101 and :118-140, scripts/check-role-word.mjs :1011-1035 and :2692-2706, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs :857, packages/skills/package.json

Inputs read: card #28476 (body and all three comments: triage 6550228889, claim 6553126668, os-dev-report 6553395266), PR #28517 (body, file list of three paths, net diff `origin/main...refs/review/pr-28517`, merge-base 23d1303d), and the check-runs on this head. The tree was judged, not the PR body's account of it.

Check-runs on af460eb4 at review time: 18 success (Auto Label; Build Core; Check Changeset; Check PR Size; Dogfood Regression Gate; Governed Surface Queue Guard; Lint · CI, release & engine gates; Lint · ESLint; Lint · PM dispatch-gates; Lint · scoped ×3; Live E2E UI; PR-body guards; Plan Test Core shards; Test UI; Type Check · source gates; filter), 13 skipped (the UI, docs, dogfood and opt-in lanes a skills-only diff does not reach), and 7 still in_progress: Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Test Core (1/8), Test Core (2/8), Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · workspace. Those seven conclusions are the gate verdicts the landing still waits on; this record does not stand in for them.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No schema, runtime or lint surface changes.** The diff touches `skills/**` and one changeset only; `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` and `filter-rule-array.ts` are byte-identical between `origin/main` and the head. Every accept-set the skill now describes is one already published on `main`. Right.
- **The accept-set the skill teaches — a `filter` list element is a flat rule or `{ or: [rule, ...] }` — is `ViewFilterElementSchema`** (view.zod.ts:1270-1300, a union of `ViewFilterRuleSchema` and `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema`, routed by `isViewFilterOrGroup`). Right.
- **"Operators (no others)" lists exactly the 20 members of `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS`** (view.zod.ts:315-325), in the enum's own order, with `in` / `not_in` marked as list values (`VIEW_FILTER_LIST_VALUE_OPERATORS` :343-345). Right. The word "no others" is honest at the typed surface; at runtime the legacy aliases in `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES` (`eq`, `gt`, `notIn`, …) still fold to canonical, but the table's own docblock says new producers MUST emit canonical forms, so a skill that teaches only the canonical set is teaching the contract, not narrowing it.
- **The four removed spellings are truly refused, not merely unlisted.** `this_week`, `this_month`, `this_quarter`, `last_n_days` appear neither in `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS` nor in `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES`; `normalizeFilterOperator` returns an unknown word verbatim and `z.preprocess(foldAuthoredViewFilterOperator, z.enum(VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS))` at :1071 refuses it at parse. The enum's docblock (:311-313) says in so many words that relative-date operators are dashboard date-range presets (`DashboardFilterSchema.defaultRange`), not filter-rule operators. Removing them is right; the old line taught a parse refusal.
- **Public surface moved: the `@objectstack/skills` npm package** (`packages/skills`, v18.2.0, whose `build` syncs the repo-root `skills/**` into `dist/skills/`). Its content changes; its API does not. Right, and it is the one package the changeset names.
- **Eval 12** is a new case in the `objectstack-ui` fixture (12 ids, 1…12, appended in the fixture's inline-array style). Nothing under `ui/` scans it (`ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` walks `ui`'s own bundles only), so no gate's accept-set changes with it. Right.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28476-skills-ui-view-filter-any-of-group.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. That matches what the diff publishes: no spec key, value or metadata type is added, narrowed or re-meant (the `{ or: [...] }` element has been on `main` since #28020), and a content change to a released package is a `patch`. No `(widening)` / `(narrowing)` arm, correctly, since nothing an author can write changed. `Check Changeset` is green on this head. `Clause-②: no`.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` in the os-dev-report (6553395266) is empty. The dev flags three things; each answered against the tree:

1. **Declared in-place fix — the operator line.** Verified as ① states: all 20 operators now listed are members of `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS`; the four removed spellings are refused at parse (absent from the enum and the alias table; `normalizeFilterOperator` passes unknown words through to the enum's own refusal). No operator was dropped that the spec accepts, none added that it refuses. The fix stays in the same section and the same gate family; it is the card's own defect class (§ Filtering teaching a shape the spec refuses). Accepted.

2. **Out-of-scope finding — stale `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker on `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema`.** CONFIRMED, and wider than the dev says. view.zod.ts:1152-1162 (docblock) and :1217-1223 (the `.describe` text, which `/meta/types` serves to authors) still say "No console reads it yet … a view that stores one is refused when it loads", and filter-rule-array.ts:193-199 puts "(declared, but no console applies it yet, so it does not narrow the rows today)" into the live refusal prose an author receives for a MongoDB-form `$or`. On `main`, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts:1389-1418` lowers the group to an `['or', ...]` node inside the list's AND, `ObjectView.tsx` / `objectGridQuery.ts` send that query, and the server's filter AST accepts the logical node (filter.zod.ts:2857-2860). So two author-facing runtime strings on the spec surface now state a false status. **Needs a card** (spec lane: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `filter-rule-array.ts`; a changeset-worthy prose correction, `Metadata-protocol: none`). Not this PR's file surface; the skill correctly follows the renderer rather than the marker.

3. **Out-of-scope finding — the docs' `{7_days_ago}` token "no console resolver reads".** REFUTED. `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts:9-46` resolves `{N_days_ago}` (the grammar the spec publishes as `DATE_MACRO_TOKENS` / `DATE_MACRO_PARAM_RE`); `resolveFilterPlaceholders` (filter-tokens.ts:300-307) composes `resolveDateMacros` with `resolveContextTokens`; and the list view's base filter passes through exactly that: `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:565` (`useResolvedFilterSegments`) and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridQuery.ts:39`, as do every `useResolvedFilter` node (kanban, calendar, gantt, tree, gallery, related lists, pickers). The dev's cited basis is wrong too: `filter-converter.ts` resolves no token at all (no `current_user_id` in it); `{current_user_id}` is resolved by `resolveContextTokens` (filter-tokens.ts:198). The docs example in `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:131` is correct as written. **No card.** The skill's choice of `priority equals urgent` over the date token is harmless, but the skill must not later be amended on the strength of this finding.

4. **Not flagged by the dev, checked here — the role-word ratchet.** The deleted `tabs`-on-object sentence carried the only "role" in `list-views.md` ("the tab-bar role"), whose `scripts/role-word-baseline.json` row is 1; the head has 0. `check-role-word.mjs` is one-sided since #26444 (`ratchetVerdict` :1011-1035 puts a decrease in `down`, printed "passing, reported" at :2693-2697), so the gate stays green; the baseline `--update` is a maintainer action per the gate's own text, not owed by this PR. No flag.

### ④ Design judgment

Every teaching sentence held against spec and code on `main`:

- **Rule-or-group list element, ANDed with siblings.** `ViewFilterElementSchema` union; `lowerViewFilterElement` lowers a group to one `['or', ...]` child of the list's AND (filter-converter.ts:1414-1418), and `ObjectView` composes the segments. Holds. The docs page (views.mdx:120-124) says the same.
- **Flat rules only; no empty `or`.** `or: z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema).min(1, …)` (view.zod.ts:1203-1210): a nested group meets `VIEW_FILTER_NESTED_GROUP_GUIDANCE` at parse via the rule's strictObject guidance (:1055-1057), and `{ or: [] }` meets the `.min(1)` message naming it. Holds.
- **"`$or`, `any` / `anyOf`, `logic` / `conditions` on a rule are refused naming this shape."** Each is a `guidance` key of `ViewFilterRuleSchema` (`VIEW_FILTER_OR_SPELLING_GUIDANCE`, :526-532), so the refusal is at **parse**, by `strictObject`'s unknown-key error map, with `VIEW_FILTER_OR_SPELLING` as the message — which names `{ or: [rule, ...] }` and says the list still ANDs. A bare `{ $or: [...] }` list element has no `or` key, so it reaches the same rule branch and the same message. The lint (`filter-walk.ts:223`) walks `$or` only in the record-form filter and steps into `or` groups via `filterGroupRules`; it refuses nothing here. "Refused naming this shape" is accurate and the channel is the parse. Holds.
- **Builder behaviour.** `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules` writes `[{ or: rules }]` for `logic: 'or'` over two or more rows (viewFilterFold.ts:228), the round-trip test shows a stored single group loading editable with the OR toggle lit and an edit writing the group back (:116-128), the toggle writing one group and back flat (:130-139), and a group beside another condition rendered with the trigger disabled under `filterOrGroupNotEditable` while the stored filter is left intact (:141-156). The runtime applies the mixed list (filter-converter). All three sentences hold. (Nuance, not a finding: an OR toggle over exactly one row is written flat, since OR and AND select the same records there; the docs page shares the simplification.)
- **The example** parses: two scalar `equals` rules inside `or`, one `equals` rule beside it; every operator is in the enum, every value a scalar. It means "open OR urgent, AND mine". `{current_user_id}` is the one context token the example uses and `resolveContextTokens` resolves it from `useFilterScope()`'s `currentUserId` (filter-tokens.ts:198). The inline note "`{current_user_id}` = the signed-in user" replaces the deleted blockquote with the same fact. Holds.
- **Eval 12.** `must_contain` `listViews`, `or: [`, `{current_user_id}`; `must_not_contain` `$or`, `logic:`, `anyOf`. A right answer in the fixture's TypeScript spelling passes (case 1 already assumes `provider: 'object'` spelling, so JSON-quoted `"or": [` failing is the fixture's standing convention, not a new trap). A wrong answer that writes `logic: 'or'`, `$or` or `anyOf` fails. Residual: a nested `{ or: [{ or: [...] }] }` or a rule carrying `conditions:` passes the substrings (and `or: [` is also a substring of `operator: [`, a spelling no plausible answer writes). The `expected_output` already names `conditions` as refused, so the assertion can follow it at no cost; `any:` cannot be added (it is a suffix of `company:`). **Should-fix:** add `"conditions:"` to `must_not_contain`. Not a must-fix: no right answer fails, and the wrong answers that pass are ones the skill text itself forbids by name.
- **`between` is unmarked.** The operator line marks `in` / `not_in` as list values but not that `between` takes exactly `[min, max]` (`VIEW_FILTER_PAIR_VALUE_OPERATORS`, view.zod.ts:355-357; refused by `checkViewFilterRuleValueShape` otherwise). An author copying `between` with a scalar meets a parse refusal the skill did not warn of. **Should-fix:** "`between` (`[min, max]`)" — four tokens against 23 of headroom. Not a must-fix: the old line taught the same omission and the refusal names the shape.
- **Deletions — no rule lost its only home, and no hunk is a pure re-wrap.** Each of the nine checked against the head tree: ① the bare-flat-view rule keeps "nothing registers and no view appears in the switcher"; ② `provider: 'object'` keeps all four capabilities and the "a view never calls an API" rule; ③ the Columns lead-in is carried by the block's "Simple" / "Enhanced" comments; ④ `tabs`-on-object keeps the rule, the parse refusal (`ObjectUserFiltersSchema`, "not dropped") and the `validate` lint — what went is the `ViewTabBar` name and the "untypable at author time" explanation, neither a rule; ⑤ omit-`userFilters` keeps "nothing is auto-derived" and the switcher-covers-presets fact; ⑥ the toolbar-search intro and blast-radius keep narrows / never widens / refuses / whole search box for every user and term — "the active view's list wins over the object's" is implied by "narrows that set for this one list" and stays verbatim in views.mdx:170-175; ⑦ wording only; ⑧ the kanban block's own comments at head L268 ("required on every list view") and L273 ("fields shown on each card") carry both facts; ⑨ the gantt sentence keeps its three facts (summary bar, dragged as a group, no resize handles) and the `locked: true` rule. Every re-wrapped line sits inside a hunk that also removes words; the ratchet prices bytes, which wrapping does not change. The three `os:check` blocks are unchanged in the diff. Ceiling row `['skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md', 3129]` is untouched.
- **Mirror with the docs.** The skill's sentences are the docs' § Base filter (views.mdx:118-140) said shorter, with the example swapped to one that uses no date token; nothing the skill teaches contradicts the docs page or the spec.

Attempts to break it that did not land: a `$or` written as a list element (same parse message); a group with a stray `field` key (`VIEW_FILTER_GROUP_STRAY_RULE_KEY_GUIDANCE`, not taught but not contradicted); a server that might refuse the `or` node (accepted, filter.zod.ts:2857); the role-word ratchet going red on the deleted "role" (one-sided, passing); the `@objectstack/skills` changeset naming a package that does not ship `skills/objectstack-ui` (it does, via `sync-catalog.mjs`).

Findings: 0 must-fix; 2 should-fix (eval 12 `must_not_contain` gains `conditions:`; the operator line marks `between` as `[min, max]`). One card owed outside this PR (③.2, the stale PLANNED marker and door prose in `packages/spec`). One dev finding refuted (③.3) — do not file it.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-0tmmio`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzCtJt8Q2Z63fyRNix`

**VERDICT: PASS**
